scope: Refresh open-source DWG writer availability and identify a reproducible, optional scratch-pair route that can shorten structural reader checks without misclassifying experimental DWG versions or promoting 3D semantics.

method.kind: Pinned release/source research and local test-owner audit
localInspection: src/libdxfrw.cpp: writeModelerGeometry and SAT carrier chunk output
tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp: runModelerDxfWriterMatrix, runDxfMixedModelerCarrierChunks, and AC1018/AC1027 modeler route tests
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: PAR-06, PAR-07/S8 peer and external evidence gates
method.sourceLimitations: LibreDWG 0.14 is a signed beta release, not a native-CAD acceptance result. Its release page calls R2010/R2013/R2018 encoding experimental and reports CRC errors on import; its tagged dxf2dwg help lists R12/R14/R2000/R2004 as valid, calls R2007 unsupported, and lists R2010+ as planned. Current master/NEWS is mutable and includes 0.14.1 development notes, not a replacement pinned release.

evidence.observed: The signed 0.14 release tag resolves to commit d9468ae and publishes the source tarball with SHA-256 62ebb73b984f865960f20ed26619ea5f8789d5e3fd088fa40a2598384da81275. The release announces R2004 DWG encoding support. It separately labels R2010/R2013/R2018 encoding experimental and says those files produce CRC errors on import. The tagged dxf2dwg help says R2007 encoding does not work and lists R12/R14/R2000/R2004 as valid targets.
doesNotEstablish: successful output for any concrete drawing or entity combination
correct output for 3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, ACDS, or arbitrary DWG objects
native AutoCAD, FreeCAD, LibreCAD, or independent-kernel acceptance
evidence.planUse: Admit only the pinned R2004 writer as an optional scratch-generation candidate after a narrow smoke run. Reject CRC-bearing R2010+ output and unsupported R2007 output as qualification inputs, even if a six-byte magic string exists.

evidence.observed: LibreDWG 0.14 accepts ASCII and binary DXF as dxf2dwg input and can write R2004 DWG. A locally authored DXF and predeclared entity/geometry manifest can therefore serve as a known-input source for a temporary AC1018 DWG, then be read by libdxfrw. The test compares against authored expectations rather than treating LibreDWG's own readback as the oracle.
doesNotEstablish: independent ACIS B-rep validity or DWG AcDs linkage
evidence.planUse: Use this as an optional composed-check alternative for a small, from-scratch AC1018 structural sample when ODA is unavailable; keep the authored manifest as the expectation and all generated files in a temporary directory.

evidence.observed: Local modeler tests already include generated SAT group-1/group-3 continuation, repeated ACDSDATA group-310 chunk replay, and ASCII/binary carrier controls. The tests establish transport and chunk ordering only, not that a peer-generated carrier is a valid B-rep. FreeCAD's DWG path remains converter-to-DXF followed by its selected DXF importer, so this old-version writer candidate cannot replace native FreeCAD or ACIS/ACDS gates.
evidence.planUse: Do not add a per-slice peer build or duplicate the existing chunk tests. Keep peer generation at the composed checkpoint, pin its artifact, and keep 2D/explicit geometry, opaque carrier preservation, geometric semantics, and native consumer acceptance as separate result lanes.

readinessRefinement: optional pinned AC1018 scratch-pair route can reduce dependence on a native DWG producer for narrow structural reader checks
keep R2007 output unsupported and R2010+ output with CRC errors out of qualification
do not run peer generators per slice; retain fast local tests as the implementation loop
keep modern ACIS/ACDS and native Linux/Windows FreeCAD gates external and independent
